WIC18A-01.note: Varve date 7,400 vs radiocarbon 8,100 with old-carbon contamination means the radiocarbon dates must be corrected; 'bracket' is the only near-miss.

WIC18A-02.note: The lake buffers growers against frost in both autumn (warming) and spring (delaying bloom); 'blanket' fits only the warming half and 'clock' only the spring timing.

WIC18A-03.note: Energy burned and head start forfeited, so only a fit gazelle can afford it: an honest costly signal. 'clear' is the only tempting distractor.

WIC18A-04.note: Rearing experiment shows tameness depends on predator exposure, i.e. circumstances; 'company' is a weak near-miss.

WIC18A-05.note: Grains lock in alignment with the field, so each flow records/captures it; 'alters' and 'bends' contradict passive recording.

WIC18A-06.note: Without trees the ebb tide removes the silt; with them the flats rise, so the roots trap/collect silt. 'compact' and 'attract' are near-misses.

WIC18A-07.note: Pooled measurements across colonies that range from 28 to 33+ give an average, not a boundary; final sentence plus first sentence decide it.

WIC18A-08.note: Worms consume the leaf layer, leaving the floor exposed; 'aerates' is the garden-benefit trap and 'colonizes' is literally true but not what the appetite does.

WIC18A-09.note: 'Out of proportion to its numbers' points to keystone/anchor, but beavers are textbook ecosystem engineers and the sea star shapes community structure, so 'architect' is also defensible; possible two-key item.

WIC18A-10.note: She replies with the other species' delay, i.e. she mimics/copies a signal not her own; 'anticipate' is the only near-miss.

WIC18B-01.note: The closing caveat (foreign sets kept for convenience, borrowed sets) makes 'determine' too strong; the proportion lets researchers estimate, i.e. gauge. Good near-miss design.

WIC18B-02.note: The postcard group kept voting two years later with no new prompt, so having voted (experience) sustains voting; 'invitation' is the trap since no one was sent anything.

WIC18B-03.note: The judge holds the sale itself represents usability without any statement, so the promise is implicit.

WIC18B-04.note: Same offices, clerks and duties under the monarchy; only the destination of receipts changed, so the minister inherited the system.

WIC18B-05.note: Final prices varied less than five percent despite wide openings, so prices were unwritten but firm; 'identical' overstates and 'familiar' is a near-miss.

WIC18B-06.note: Sound loans plus a bank run means the rumor creates the shortage; 'fabricate' (invent falsely) and 'hasten' (shortage was coming anyway) are good near-misses.

WIC18B-07.note: Unknown days worked means day rates alone cannot establish annual earnings: insufficient. 'inflated' is a mild trap.

WIC18B-08.note: Constant bias still lets the panel track trends, so its figures are informative; 'flawless' and 'impartial' contradict the stated tilt.

WIC18B-09.note: Stepwise, gradual transmission from banks to firms to households is 'filters through'; 'drifts' and 'flickers' also take 'through' but miss the sense.

WIC18B-10.note: Departures from stock phrases reflect the writer's own feelings, so they are the most direct evidence; 'eloquent' and 'dramatic' are tempting surface fits.

WIC18C-01.note: Notes faded within a second, so trills and repeated notes kept a melodic line sounding: maintain. 'polish' is the decorative trap.

WIC18C-02.note: Larger windows (lighting) failed; moving the room to face a garden worked, and the eastern branch faces a park, so the view/outlook decides. 'location' is a near-miss but the buildings share decades and plans and the fix was within one building.

WIC18C-03.note: Dialogue was invented but events were fixed and takes stopped, so the improvisation was more limited than reviewers implied.

WIC18C-04.note: Actors had only their own parts with short cues that could recur anywhere, so they had to listen closely (monitor); 'memorize' is impossible without the full text.

WIC18C-05.note: Phrases first tried in the letters and verse forms first appearing there make the letters her most original/inventive writing; 'lyrical' and 'moving' are near-misses.

WIC18C-06.note: No money for backdrops, costumes and machinery so a concert version was given; critics regretted no one could fully stage (mount) it. 'premiere' fails since it premiered in the nineteenth century.

WIC18C-07.note: The choir sinks lower while staying in tune with itself, so its pitch no longer matches the organ.

WIC18C-08.note: Signature applied over later varnish undermines the attribution to the painter; patron is fixed by the frame inscription.

WIC18C-09.note: Night is conveyed only through dialogue in daylight, so spectators must imagine/picture it.

WIC18C-10.note: Melodies appear note for note and fit seamlessly, so he quoted them; 'parodied' fails because nothing sounds out of place.

WIC18D-01.note: Vowel insertion in loans decides between rule and accident, so loanwords resolve the question; 'sharpen' is a near-miss.

WIC18D-02.note: Planners preferred the clinic that vaccinated far more people overall despite lower completion: reach. 'thoroughness' describes the rejected first clinic.

WIC18D-03.note: No wire snapped in six months, so quick-surfacing flaws can be excluded: rule out. 'track down' implies flaws were found.

WIC18D-04.note: For non-word errors the list method is reliable/valid, i.e. sound; 'simple' is a true-but-irrelevant trap.

WIC18D-05.note: Parallel running exposes dropped or altered entries before relying on the software alone: test it.

WIC18D-06.note: High frequency returns echoes from structures less than a millimeter apart as distinct signals, so the probe can separate closely spaced fibers; 'target' is a near-miss.

WIC18D-07.note: Under one sixth the tests at same price for nearly as many cases means far higher yield per cost: return. 'scope' was narrower, not greater.

WIC18D-08.note: Basic vocabulary changes slowly, so comparisons use the stable core; 'vital' is a near-miss collocate.

WIC18D-09.note: The reaction runs for weeks and halts without water, so adding water sustains it; 'triggers' fails since it began at mixing.

WIC18D-10.note: Staff already know the fact; the sign reminds them at the key moment, i.e. refreshes the knowledge rather than teaching it.
